overview_description.description: OCTA offers an accounts receivable automation platform that enables finance and sales teams to manage the entire contract-to-cash process using AI-driven workflows. It includes features such as e-signature, automated invoicing, payment follow-ups, reconciliation, and invoice financing, all within a unified interface. The platform integrates with common accounting, CRM, and payment systems—such as QuickBooks and Zoho—to synchronize data, reduce manual tasks, and provide payment options like credit card and bank transfer. OCTA emphasizes visibility into payment status via real‑time dashboards and AI agents that extract contract terms and trigger reminders automatically. This solution supports different industries—such as technology and logistics—by streamlining collections and enabling predictable cash flow
